Definition: Jojada, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Jehoiada is named 5 times in the Bible, and the passages here are Nehemiah 3:6; Nehemiah 12:10; Nehemiah 12:11. In Nehemiah 3:6 we read, "Moreover the old gate repaired Jehoiada the son of Paseah, and Meshullam the son of Besodeiah..." The same name belongs to more than one man, and Nehemiah 12:11 names another of them.
TheologicalSignificance: Jehoiada is written down once, and I take that as proof God counts individuals. That is why I do not skip the lists: every name in them was loved.
RelatedPeople: Jehoiada, Son of Paseah; Joiada, Son of Eliashib
